method: Retrieve candidate pages with ordinary HTTPS GET and no account/API registration. Redirects remain on allowlisted official hosts. Likumi.lv acts are extracted from doc-body; identified Drupal guidance pages use block--system-main; other official pages use their configured main-content container. Official PDFs are retained byte-for-byte; text extraction and PDF signature validation remain unimplemented.
change_detection: Preserve and record the exact response hash. For HTML comparison, ignore script elements, Drupal js-view-dom-id hashes, and the rotating csrf-token value identified in repeated captures; retain all other markup and links in the comparison digest. A remaining response change is staged under temp/latvia/pending for manual review and Monitor archiving; accepted documents are never overwritten. PDFs use exact-byte hashes. No source is automatically accepted.
publisher_terms: Likumi.lv terms and Latvijas Vēstnesis reuse procedures govern recurring retained or systematised copies; ordinary official links remain separately accepted. Thirty selected text copies were accepted within their per-record scope. Newly retrieved or converted outputs remain unaccepted until review.
